explanation: At the modeling stage, the focus is on identifying the relevant facts and relationships, such as suppliers, products, and orders. Exact SQL, permissions, and screen design are later implementation concerns.

options.text: Only the facts and relationships needed to represent the business situation
The exact SQL statements that will create the tables and indexes
The employee permissions required to update each table
The screen layout users will see when entering orders

prompt: A designer proposes storing `Supplier`, `Product`, and `Order` because the business needs to track who supplies what and what was ordered. Which statement best matches what a data model should capture at this stage?
